name: debate
description: Dialectical decision analysis: dispatch parallel advocate agents to research opposing perspectives, optionally fact-check claims, challenge the consensus with devil's advocacy, and independently synthesize a verdict. Three modes (Quick/Standard/Deep) control pipeline depth. Not for factual lookups or simple preferences.

interface.longDescription: Dispatches parallel advocate agents to research opposing perspectives on a decision, optionally fact-checks their claims and challenges the leading position with devil's advocacy, then synthesizes an opinionated verdict with a confidence percentage.
defaultPrompt: Should I do X or Y?
